cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message "name must not be null"
cases.description: Calling findRecords with a null Name should fail early with an IllegalArgumentException.
An invalid DNS type (negative value) should be rejected by Type.check, causing an IllegalArgumentException.
The supplied name is not a subdomain of the zone origin, therefore findRecords should immediately return a SetResponse indicating NXDOMAIN.
When the name equals the zone origin but the origin itself is not a subdomain of itself according to the implementation (origin.subdomain(origin) returns false), the method should return NXDOMAIN.

cases.expected: SetResponse of type SUCCESS containing an RRset for A records of www.example.com.
cases.description: The name is a subdomain of the zone origin and an A record exists; findRecords should return a SUCCESS SetResponse with the matching RRset.
The name is within the zone but there is no MX (type 15) RRset for it; the method should return NXRRSET.

cases.expected: SetResponse of type SUCCESS containing all RRsets for www.example.com.
cases.description: When the caller requests type ANY (255), findRecords should return a SUCCESS SetResponse that aggregates every RRset associated with the name.

cases.expected: SetResponse of type CNAME containing the CNAME RRset for alias.example.com.
cases.description: The name exists in the zone but only as a CNAME record; findRecords should return a CNAME SetResponse.

cases.expected: SetResponse of type SUCCESS (same as normal lookup) and no deadlock or exception.
cases.description: Invoking findRecords while another thread holds a read lock should succeed because the method acquires its own read lock via withReadLock; this case validates that no concurrency‑related exception is thrown.
Zone instance has a null `origin`. When `findRecords` calls `name.subdomain(origin)`, a NullPointerException is thrown because `origin` is null.
The DNS type value exceeds the valid 16‑bit range. `Type.check` should reject it and throw an IllegalArgumentException.
A subclass or spy of `Zone` overrides `findRecordsWithoutLock` to throw an IllegalStateException. The exception must propagate out of `findRecords` (i.e., not be caught or transformed).
